test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the rank of the services sector in terms of the top recipient of FDI equity in FY 2024-25, as per the data of Ministry of Commerce and Industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**First**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **services sector** has consistently been a top contributor to India's economy, playing a crucial role in attracting **Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)**.
 
• As per the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry**, in FY 2024-25, the services sector emerged as the **top recipient of FDI equity**.
 
• This sector includes key industries such as **IT & IT-enabled services (ITeS), banking, financial services, insurance, real estate, and consulting**, which remain attractive to foreign investors.
 
• The ranking signifies the importance of the sector in driving **economic growth**, creating employment opportunities, and fostering technological advancements in India.
 
• The focus on digitalization, policy reforms, and government initiatives such as **Startup India** and **Digital India** has further boosted FDI inflows into the services sector.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is First.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **FDI in the Services Sector:**

 
 
• The services sector has been a critical driver of **FDI inflows** in India, attracting investment from countries like the **USA, UK, Singapore, and Japan**.
 
• It is preferred due to India's **skilled workforce, cost competitiveness, and growing consumer base**.
 
• Sectors such as **software services, telecommunications, and financial services** are the leading recipients within the services domain.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• **Startup India:** Encourages entrepreneurship and innovation, attracting foreign venture capital.
 
• **Digital India:** Focuses on digital infrastructure, e-governance, and online services, enhancing the IT sector's appeal to investors.
 
• **Make in India:** Aims to promote India as a global manufacturing and services hub.
 
 
 
• **FDI Equity Inflows:**
 
 
• FDI equity inflows reflect the confidence of international investors in India's economic policies and growth potential.
 
• In FY 2024-25, the services sector accounted for the largest share, emphasizing its strategic importance.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **FDI Trends:**

 
 
• India has witnessed a continuous rise in **FDI inflows**, driven by policy liberalization and investor-friendly measures.
 
• The **services sector** remains the most sought-after, followed by other sectors like manufacturing and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Contribution to GDP:**
 
 
• The services sector contributes over **50%** to India's **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**, underlining its economic significance.
